cases.prompt: Which compiler flags should our security-sensitive C++ service build with? We use Clang and libc++.
expectations: Lists warning flags (-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic, optionally -Werror) and -Wunsafe-buffer-usage for Clang.
Includes hardening flags such as -fstack-clash-protection, -ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero, PIE and full RELRO.
Recommends running ASan and UBSan in CI (and TSan for concurrent code).
